text:
alex: Heads-up — release CI failing on regen diff for the sample-app onboarding branch, looks like typegen churn
ci-bot: buildkite: #4421 failed (yarn build -> yarn regen -> yarn test) :x:
maya: Error from the TS job: generated `types.ts` reorders params on `CreateUserReq`, TS compile errors everywhere
ben: Also seeing changelog-generator create a minor bump on the release PR even though only docs changed — that triggered a semver guard and blocked publish
sam: Can you paste the smallest failing diff? I suspect nondeterministic OpenAPI property sorting again
alex: here's the core of the diff:
```diff
- export interface CreateUserReq { name: string; role?: string }
+ export interface CreateUserReq { role?: string; name: string }
```
maya: Yup that's the one. Our typegen sorts properties by property name when example payloads are present. If the OpenAPI array ordering isn't stable the generated file flips order sometimes
julie: CI matrix added node 20 last week — could tiny changes in prettier/tsc output across node/npm cause subtle regen diffs?
ben: The changelog bot uses file-hash to decide bump type; since `types.ts` changed, it treated it as feature -> minor even though it's codegen noise. We should ignore generated artifacts for semver decisions
leo: short-term mitigation: add a regen-stable flag to typegen to canonicalize object keys and stabilize ordering
sam: Can someone try running `yarn typegen --stable` locally and commit the updated golden file? If that fixes the CI diff we can proceed with the release
alex: trying locally now — running:
```bash
yarn install && yarn typegen --stable && git add src/types.ts && git commit -m "typegen: stabilize property ordering for CreateUserReq"
```
ci-bot: alex pushed a fix to the branch — build retriggered :arrow_forward:
maya: After that build, tests still fail, but it's just the sample-app e2e that times out — looks like onboarding script expects REDWOOD_ONBOARD env var that the CI runner doesn't set
ben: ugh. The sample-app onboarding script uses a local-only fallback. On CI we should set REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false in the matrix to skip interactive steps
julie: I'll push a tiny CI change to set REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false and skip the interactive flow. Also adding generated files to .semver-ignore for the changelog bot
alex: Thanks — both fixes are small. Once CI is green we can un-block the release. Good catch on the semver logic, Ben. :thumbsup:
sam: Follow-up: we should add a lightweight regen check to the PR template that asks "did you run `yarn typegen --stable`?" to reduce future noise
leo: Agreed. I'll open a quick PR with the PR checklist and a note about node matrix parity across runners
maya: sweet. also leaving a note in the devex docs about deterministic codegen and the `--stable` flag
alex: closing loop — once CI green I'll merge. Thanks team! :rocket:
